content.text: Stripe's availability map covers 46 countries. PayPal's risk engine flags accounts from Nigeria, Ghana, Pakistan, Bangladesh, and dozens of other markets before any human review occurs. Gumroad holds payouts for up to 30 days in certain regions. Lemon Squeezy and Paddle are unavailable across most of Africa, South Asia, and Latin America. These are not temporary oversights waiting to be corrected — they are deliberate structural decisions built into conventional [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/usdt-payment-gateways-digital-products-what-actually-how-16|USDT Payment]] infrastructure designed for Western banking systems. The solution is not finding a workaround inside this system. It is [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-building-crypto-store-cloudflare-pages-complete-infrastructure-25|building]] on infrastructure that does not have the problem in the first place. That means GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, and NOWPayments for automatic on-chain payment verification. No platform can restrict access to a store that runs under your own accounts with no dependency on any payment processor.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: The Complete Guide to Selling Digital Products Without Stripe at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/comparing-real-options-selling-digital-products-without-stripe-2. content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Software stripe

Stripe, PayPal, Gumroad, Lemon Squeezy, and Paddle offer a range of services for digital [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-creator-built-payment-infrastructure-south-asian-creators-2|COREMERCH guide to creator]]s to sell their products online. However, their availability and functionality vary greatly depending on the creator's location. For instance, Stripe's and PayPal's restrictions in certain countries limit their usefulness, while Gumroad and Lemon Squeezy face similar geographic limitations. In contrast, sovereign commerce infrastructure provides a comprehensive solution, including hosting, backend logic, order storage, and payment processing, without the need for these restricted platforms.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Platforms like Stripe, PayPal, and Gumroad have specific rules and restrictions for creators in certain countries. These restrictions can lead to account suspensions or limitations on receiving payments. A PayPal account suspension, for example, can hold funds for up to 180 days with no appeal, causing significant financial hardship for creators. Sovereign commerce infrastructure, on the other hand, operates independently of these restrictions, providing creators with full control over their digital storefronts and payments.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

The speed and cost of payment processing vary significantly between traditional platforms and sovereign commerce infrastructure. While Stripe and PayPal charge transaction fees and may have slower payment processing times, sovereign commerce infrastructure, such as NOWPayments, offers fast and low-cost transactions, with fees as low as 0.5%. This difference in fees and payment speed can greatly impact a creator's profitability and cash flow.
Sovereign commerce infrastructure empowers creators with full ownership and control over their digital storefronts and payments.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

The asymmetric risk of platform dependency becomes concrete only when the platform acts. While a PayPal or Stripe account is functioning normally, the risk feels theoretical and distant. When it stops functioning — through suspension, policy change, or geographic restriction enforcement — the creator loses their revenue channel instantly, often with funds already inside the platform that cannot be withdrawn. The conventional appeals process rarely reverses these decisions because the original decision was made algorithmically and the human review process operates on the platform's timeline and criteria, not yours. Sovereign infrastructure eliminates this asymmetry entirely. Your Cloudflare Pages storefront cannot be suspended by a payment processor's compliance decision. Your wallet cannot be frozen by anyone.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

For creators facing platform restrictions, sovereign commerce infrastructure offers a reliable and efficient alternative. By choosing solutions like the Edge Commerce Stack, creators can deploy a fully operational online store with automatic crypto payment processing, instant product delivery, and full data ownership. This infrastructure sovereignty allows creators to operate independently, without the risks associated with traditional platforms, and ensures their businesses can thrive regardless of geographic location.
